name: Trustap Payment Gateway
author: dinotrustap

sections.description:
Trustap is an end-to-end transaction solution for your e-commerce store, handling everything from payments to chargeback management to customer support in one seamless platform.

MAJOR FEATURES OF THE TRUSTAP PAYMENT PLUGIN FOR WOOCOMMERCE:

  • All-in-one transaction solution: Replace multiple plugins with a single platform. Trustap brings together secure payment processing, fraud detection, chargeback management and customer support, simplifying your tech stack and reducing operational overhead.
  • Flexible pricing: With tiered pricing options, choose a plan that aligns with your margins and growth goals.
  • Dispute resolution & customer support: Our support team mediates and resolves disputes globally on your behalf, ensuring fair outcomes and saving your team valuable time.
  • Chargeback management: Trustap’s specialists minimise chargeback impact through proactive prevention and efficient resolution workflows.
  • Buyer protection: Funds are held securely until the product is received by the customer, adding an extra layer of protection for the buyer.
  • Payment Options: Accepts payment from a wide range of payment options, such as debit/credit card, wallets, bank redirects, bank transfer and more.
  • Security: PCI Level 1 Security via Stripe.
sections.installation:
1. Install Trustap Payment Gateway extension directly via the WordPress plugin directory or download the latest from [our plugin page on WordPress.org](https://wordpress.org/plugins/trustap-payment-gateway/ “Trustap Payment Gateway) and upload trustap-payment-gateway.zip file via the WordPress plugin upload page.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Once you activated the plugin navigate to settings page of WooCommerce / Settings / Payments / Trustap Payments.
  4. Make sure Enable Trustap Payments is checked.
  5. To enable Test Mode make sure the Enable Test Mode is checked. If you want to disable Test mode and go live make sure it’s disabled.
  6. Under Trustap Test Key fill out the field with the key you received in your email and click Login. After Registering/Login accept the terms and you are all set! For Production the flow is the same except Trustap Live Key is needed.
  7. You are all set!
